messages:
Matt R.: FYI - vendor just flagged one inbound RMA pallet (10 H100s) held at FRA customs for additional paperwork. They asked if we want diversion to AMS to bypass the FRA backlog.

Erin K.: What's AMS turnaround vs FRA? Weighing reroute cost vs SLA risk.

Sam L.: Current eu-gpu-pool snapshot: capacity_slots=30, healthy=28, allocated=25, spare=5. avg_queue_latency=18m. If those 10 units are delayed 48h+, spare dips under 5% during peak windows. A few staging jobs already queued.

Leila D.: Depot update: FRA QA queue ~60-80h right now. AMS is faster (~24-36h) but has a one-time pre-notify fee and stricter inbound photo requirements.

Matt R.: Vendor quote for diversion: EUR 1,350 per AWB + EUR 250 docs/reconsignment. Transit delta ~30h. Also note AMS depot charges EUR 75 pre-notify/photo fee.

Erin K.: Any option for partial release so we only divert 6 and leave 4 for FRA inspection? That could balance cost vs risk. @Ops Oncall

Ops Oncall: Partial release OK but requires serial manifest update and reconsignment docs. Expect ~3-5 hours admin overhead. No legal blocks.

Sam L.: Quick cost calc: if we divert and clear in 36h we avoid emergency burst from our US spare (cross-region transfer cost and tokenized SLA exposure) — rough savings ~EUR 2,200/day in operational churn + potential SLA credits. Diversion cost ~EUR 1,675 total. Net positive for >1 day saved.

Leila D.: Heads-up: AMS QA measured a +15% rework rate last month for H100 RMAs (additional depop/repack time). If we reroute, allocate extra QA time.

Matt R.: Erin, can you approve diversion to AMS and finance sign-off? VendorOps will need go-ahead to finalize AWB.

Erin K.: Approved to reroute to AMS. Finance please pre-approve the one-off redirect expense; we'll reconcile on vendor statement.

VendorOps Bot: NovaLogix status: tentative AWB booked NLX-AMS-998877. ETA AMS inbound +36h. Fees: EUR 1,350 (redirect) + EUR 250 (reconsign) + EUR 75 (AMS pre-notify) = EUR 1,675. Pending e-signature on reconsignment.

Matt R.: @Leila please reserve 6 QA slots on AMS arrival and prepare for potential extra rework. Also tag internal RMA case ID on the vendor manifest.

Leila D.: Created depot ticket AMS-DEP-8821. Requested AWB photos and serial manifest. Will update when photos arrive.

Sam L.: I'll temporarily increase preemption on eu-ops-candidate to free 4 slots for 12h and pause non-critical nightly CI to free another 2. That should reduce immediate pressure while AMS inbound completes.

Finance Team: Noted. We have pre-approved up to EUR 2,000 for unplanned logistics. Please forward consolidated invoice and serial manifest to procurement@redwood.com.

Matt R.: Action list: 1) VendorOps sign reconsignment (Matt) 2) Depot slot reservation & photo verify (Leila) 3) Short-term preemption bump (Sam) 4) Finance invoice routing (Erin/Finance). I'll monitor and close when AWB and depot slots confirmed.

Ops Oncall: If customs release is denied at AMS, fallback is cross-region draw from US pool or partial reroute back to FRA. We'll escalate immediately if that happens.

Sales Ops: Heads-up to Customer Success: potentially impacted customers: SearchCorp and PixelLabs. Recommend holding customer comms until final ETA but be ready to inform if SLA window shifts.

Matt R.: VendorOps please push final AWB and e-signed docs to #vendors and tag me. Closing thread after AMS arrival confirmed.

VendorOps Bot: Reconsignment e-signed and uploaded: AWB NLX-AMS-998877. AMS depot photos uploaded to DEP-8821. Estimated AMS clearance in ~34 hours. Closing update pending depot QA slot confirmation.
